rows.text: The Astral Ecology School's work on Shattered Star Bait yielded a new substance that had an enticing effect on void song whales and other large creatures. This innovation propelled the advancement of the space whaling industry, accelerating ecological deterioration. According to unreliable sources, the IPC had originally planned to use it to lure Luxbane, until relevant personnel discovered during a large-scale experiment that humans were also attracted to it.
